$comment: Recorded pack sizes, refreshed 2026-09-14 and the refresh is the story. `check:artifacts` existed, `artifact-size-ratchet-lock.test.ts` unit-tested its verdict function against synthetic inputs, and **no workflow ever ran the verdict against the real packages** — so seven of them drifted past this file unchallenged: closeout +268%, seniority +112%, paratext +87%, burgee +51%, caique +46%, flagstaff +15%, linegauge +11%. The growth is explained — the PLAN 1.1 schema fold put a 6.5 KB family schema in every package that reaches the plugin registry, and waves 1 and 3 added plugin hosts and drop-in façades — but explaining growth is not the same as accepting it, which is why the numbers are named here rather than quietly replaced. `npm run lint` runs the check now, so the next one is caught. **caique moved 2026-09-20**, 28,379 -> 35,802 packed and 84,388 -> 110,328 unpacked (+26.2% / +30.7%), for the two drop-in façades `caique/inquirer` (41 / 41 against `@inquirer/core`'s own suite) and `caique/clack`. It was trimmed first, not bumped first: caique's build gained `scripts/strip-comments.mjs`, the same step closeout has always run, which took the same tree from 53,659 / 160,996 down to these numbers. What is left is the façades themselves, which is code rather than prose and cannot be argued below a 10% allowance. Every per-entry budget in `packages/caique/src/weight.test.ts` was re-measured and lowered in the same commit.
